This is the second Release Candidate of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source.

Release Candidates are feature-complete pre-releases. Pre-releases are not suitable for production use.

### New Features

- #16082 Update the Search module to include all RedisSearch-related content that was intended for RC1

- RediSearch/RediSearch#11202 Incomplete UTF-8 characters no longer reads out of bounds in indexed TEXT fields. (MOD-18088)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11230 Hash documents are no longer re-indexed when no vector indexed field is touched. (MOD-17688)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10872 Shard no longer crashes with SIGSEGV when `RESTORE` of a legacy `ft_index0` payload is issued outside an RDB load. (MOD-15685)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10728 GC timer arming off the main thread on ARM no longer causes random shard crash

1. JDBC: Support ZooKeeper and ETCD URL format - [#37037](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/pull/37037)
1. Metadata: Support IPv6 for JDBC connection URL - [#35289](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/issues/35289)
1. Metadata: Support to load partition tables for PostgreSQL - [#34346](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/pull/34346)
1. SQL Parser: Support to parse stored procedure syntax for MySQL - [#36690](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/pull/36690)
1. SQL Parser: Support to pars

1. Kernel: Add firebird SQL parser module and database type [#33773](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/pull/33773)
1. SQL Parser: Support parsing MySQL by adding non-reserved keywords in BaseRule.g4 file according to MySQL 8.4 doc - [#33846](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/pull/33846)
1. SQL Parser: Support MySQL update with statement parse - [#34126](https://github.com/apache/shardingsphere/pull/34126)
1. Storage: Support setting `hive_conf_list`, `hive_var_list` and `sess_var_list` for jdb

1. Kernel: Add new doris, hive and presto sql parser module and database type
1. SQL Parser: Support MySQL change replication with no server ids
1. SQL Parser: Support MySQL row and column aliases with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
1. SQL Parser: Support MySQL CALL sql with mysql prefix
1. SQL Parser: Support MySQL create loadable function returns int/dec
1. SQL Parser: Support parsing MySQL CREATE TABLESPACE/TABLE in Mysql-8
1. SQL Parser: Support parsing MySQL CREATE INDEX with ENGINE_ATTRIBUTE
1. SQL Parser: S

* Fix schema sync failing to drop a stale unique index on MySQL https://github.com/SeaQL/sea-orm/pull/3202
.all(db)
Removing `#[sea_orm(unique)]` from a column could make the next schema sync fail with MySQL error 1064.
`with-arrow` now builds against arrow 60. Arrow types passed to SeaORM, such as a `RecordBatch` for `from_arrow`, must come from arrow 60 too, so crates like `parquet` need the matching version.
Upgrade arrow to 60 (sea-orm-arrow 2.0.0-rc.5)

* Support `postgres:db_name` connection URLs https://github.com/SeaQL/sea-orm/pull/3197
Entity::find().select_also(other::Entity).build(DbBackend::Postgres)
The implementation now explicitly uses `sea_orm::DbErr`.
sea-orm-cli generate entity -u postgres:my_db -o src/entities

* **Security:** `multidict` is bumped for CVE-2026-104874 (#3507), MySQL connections can enable TLS via Secrets Manager or the new `ssl_context` parameter (#3472), and Redshift COPY/UNLOAD escapes S3 paths and KMS key IDs (#3461).
* **Stricter validation of caller-supplied SQL fragments** (#3483, #3484, #3532). Malformed type strings passed via `dtype=` to `to_sql`, Athena Iceberg DDL column types, and PostgreSQL `upsert_conflict_columns` / `insert_conflict_columns` now raise `InvalidArgumentValue` instead
* fix: handle zero max_items_evaluated in DynamoDB read_items by @hsusul in https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-pandas/pull/3417
* feat(dynamodb): add key_schema parameter to read_items to bypass Desc… by @jagannalla in https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-pandas/pull/3352

在参考方案基础上额外修复的三个问题（均已在 DamengClient 中处理）：
1,DECIMAL 精度缺失报错 达梦建表时未指定精度会导致： DECIMAL precision must be in range [1, 38]: 0 处理：precision 为 0 时默认按最大精度 38 处理。
2,TIMESTAMP 精度换算报错 达梦驱动返回的时间类型列宽与其他数据库不同，触发： VerifyException: Unexpected timestamp precision 16 calculated from timestamp column size 36 处理：按达梦驱动的列宽规则
